review_items.concrete_reason: The south-east door opens into an empty strip; armchair_reading and floor_lamp_reading sit north of the door clearance, and bed_sleep is well west of the incoming route.

All four declared targets are reachable from the door through the east-side lane and center. The route reaches wardrobe_clothes without crossing the bed egress area and reaches nightstand_sleep around the bed's north-east corner.

bed_sleep has a clear east-side making and egress zone; nightstand_sleep is reachable from the bed's north side; wardrobe_clothes has unobstructed south-facing dressing space; and the reading chair's north-west approach remains free of its support table and lamp.

bed_sleep and nightstand_sleep make a compact sleep group while armchair_reading, side_table_reading, and floor_lamp_reading form an independent day-reading group rather than scattering occasional furniture around the bed.

The large bed and north-wall wardrobe establish the two required bedroom masses, while the center and east-side lane remain intentionally open for dressing and passage instead of overfilling the room with duplicate bedside furniture.

The bed head is against the west wall with access toward the room, wardrobe_clothes faces into a usable dressing area, and armchair_reading turns toward its open approach rather than toward a wall or the doorway.
bed_sleep is the dominant west-side sleeping anchor, wardrobe_clothes is the secondary north-side utility anchor, and the smaller reading group is clearly subordinate in the south-east.

The closest bedroom_003 uses a north-wall bed, two nightstands, a west-wall wardrobe, and no reading lamp. This scene rotates the bed to the west wall, uses one north-side nightstand, moves the wardrobe north-east, and builds a distinct five-edge frozen partner graph.
